message: パスワードは語る

name: Synn
message: 「Morning!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa! Why are you already awake and getting ready for school?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't wake up--I never went to sleep」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My plan to stare at your sleeping face to my heart's content and then beat you awake is totally ruined!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're sure lively first thing in the morning」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you here so early?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually, I couldn't sleep either」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, what I was worried about was you, though...」
Nanaka gazed intently at my face.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've made up your mind」
She seemed to figure it out from the fact that I wasn't looking down.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see」

name: Synn
message: 「You too, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Same as you, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I hadn't, you'd definitely have a terrible look on your face right now」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, why did you come so early in the morning, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've got something I want to show you」
The startup chime of a laptop echoes through the Student Council room, where the cold winter air hangs completely still.

name: Synn
message: 「What is it you wanted to show me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a sec」
Working the mouse, Nanaka clicks on a folder containing the photos Azel selected for the Holy Night Festival exhibition.
A small window pops up prompting for a password.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What I want to show you is the password」
Accompanied by the brisk clatter of the keyboard, the word typed in was--
『ＳＡＫＵＲＡＳＹＮＮ』
When Nanaka clicked "Enter," the folder opened, displaying thumbnails of photos Azel had taken of the entire student body.
For some reason, my cheeks grew hot.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well. That's how it is」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way a girl who'd destroy the world could ever fall for you, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if it ticks me off to admit it as a former rival」

name: Ria
message: 「So that's how it was...」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai?!」

name: Misa
message: 「A situation like this is kind of maidenly and nice\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even Misa?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm. If it's the president's name, she certainly wouldn't forget it」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're missing the point」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone, how long have you been there?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought Synn-kun might be worried and come in early this morning. As your upperclassman, I had to be here to hear you out」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like there was nothing to worry about, though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I came because I wanted to hurry and tell everyone that there's nothing to worry about!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I was worried about Sakura-kun or anything」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just that I thought if things stayed like this, it would interfere with preparations for the Holy Night Festival, so we needed to hold an early-morning meeting」

name: Misa
message: 「That's all! That's the only reason!」
Without even needing a meeting, everyone seemed to have reached the exact same conclusion.
Still, saying it out loud felt way too much like a cheesy youth drama, making it a little embarrassing.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, Nanaka, how did you figure it out?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... W-Well, you know, uh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, just take a hint already!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're way too dense!」

name: Ria
message: 「I really can't defend this one」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's because there's no worry of forgetting it」

name: Paqy
message: 「I bet Soba uses this for her home computer password too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-How do you know that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bullseye」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Narga!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oops, I can't just stand around like this! I have something I must tell everyone! It's a revelation from God!」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yesterday I got swept up in the serious atmosphere of the three older women and couldn't talk back, but」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-She's a brave one...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When I was taking a bubbly bath at home, maybe I was thinking too hard, because I fell asleep and got dizzy from the heat」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「At that moment, God emerged from the bubbles」

name: Ria
message: 「What kind of god?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They were radiating light from behind their head, wearing bright red clothes and a red turban, doing a yoga pose on a lotus pedestal, and riding a treasure ship pulled by reindeer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where on earth is that god from?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「God said, 'Everyone get along, okay?'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When I woke up with a start, I was in my bed. Since I'm a good girl, God must have carried me there」

name: Synn
message: 「Wasn't that just Riesling?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even Azel must have been taught that God said everyone should get along」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So any god trying to make Azel and us fight is a liar. They definitely aren't God at all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why there's no need to play along with some con artist's scheme!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're right. Azel's our friend, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! I will never fight!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No matter how much a power-hungry vice president threatens me, I won't attack Azel!」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude! Even I wouldn't say something like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel looked so pained when she realized she had been attacking us!」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no way someone like that could destroy the world. That's all there is to it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides. Even if we forced ourselves to go along with it and attacked Azel... we wouldn't be able to do it properly」

name: Synn
message: 「That goes for Azel too」
I looked at the photos Azel had taken.

name: Synn
message: 「Because Azel has come to know who we are」
Is it naive?
Is it too naive a thought when we're trying to save the world?

name: Ria
message: 「Come to think of it, the Bylous is still around, isn't it. I wonder if it'll come?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It isn't our friend, so let's defeat it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd say it counts as part of everyone, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, we're all agreed on not attacking Azel, right? What do we do after that?」

name: Misa
message: 「We're going to confirm that we can't fight, aren't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... for starters, I'll ask her to dance」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, got it. How passionate. Starting to feel stupid for worrying about it」

name: Ria
message: 「And if she turns you down, it's the end of the world, right」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Please don't put that kind of pressure on me」
